premise: Beaver builds dens for everyone; Bear cub doesn't fit for three tries, until Rabbit, who heard the third one creak, suggests measuring, and the fourth fits exactly.
inspiration: Goldilocks' three sizes, turned: nothing is too big or too small once someone builds it to fit you.
lesson: The right help starts by paying attention to who you're helping.

en-US.title: A Den for Bear Cub
en-US.text: Along came {beaver:enter} Beaver, waddling with his stick. He built the best dens in the forest. [excited] Who needs a den? Up toddled the {bear:enter} bear cub. {bear:face happy} Me! {beaver:live} Beaver gnawed his stick, chomp-chomp, chips flying, then held it up and patted it proudly. He built a den. {beaver:face surprised} Too small! The bear cub's paws {bear:wobble} stuck out of the door. [giggles] He built another. Too small! His ears poked out of the roof. He built a third, and {rabbit:enter} Rabbit came hopping over to look. {rabbit:live hold} His ears shot straight up. Creeeak… {bear:face sad} {bear:shake} {sfx:flump} FLUMP! {rabbit:live resume} Rabbit relaxed and nibbled a clover. [curious] Why not measure him first? So they measured the bear cub, from his ears to his toes. {beaver:face happy} Then Beaver built one more, {sfx:build} round and cosy. {bear:go to beaver} The bear cub crawled inside. {bear:face happy} It fitted exactly. {bear:live hold} He yawned, stretched up high, rubbed his eyes… and nodded off. [whispers] Just right, said Beaver. {beaver:hearts} {rabbit:hearts}

es-ES.title: Una guarida para el osito
es-ES.text: Llegó {beaver:enter} Castor, bamboleándose con su palo. Construía las mejores guaridas del bosque. [excited] ¿Quién necesita una guarida? Se acercó el {bear:enter} osito, a pasitos. {bear:face happy} ¡Yo! {beaver:live} Castor royó su palo, ñam-ñam, volando astillas, luego lo levantó y le dio unas palmaditas, muy orgulloso. Construyó una guarida. {beaver:face surprised} ¡Demasiado pequeña! Las patas del osito {bear:wobble} salían por la puerta. [giggles] Construyó otra. ¡Demasiado pequeña! Las orejas le salían por el tejado. Construyó una tercera, y {rabbit:enter} Conejo llegó dando saltos a mirar. {rabbit:live hold} Se le pusieron las orejas tiesas. Crrrec… {bear:face sad} {bear:shake} {sfx:flump} ¡PLAF! {rabbit:live resume} Conejo se relajó y mordisqueó un trébol. [curious] ¿Y si lo medís primero? Así que midieron al osito, de las orejas a los dedos de los pies. {beaver:face happy} Y Castor construyó una más, {sfx:build} redonda y calentita. {bear:go to beaver} El osito se metió dentro. {bear:face happy} Cabía justo. {bear:live hold} Bostezó, se estiró bien alto, se frotó los ojos… y se quedó dormido. [whispers] Perfecta, dijo Castor. {beaver:hearts} {rabbit:hearts}
